scope: Fresh immutable server DOM, ancestor attributes, all 21 unique actual href stylesheet bytes, 590 font declarations and all 38 conservatively retained font selector candidates; additional layout selector inventory. No live style engine.
manual_findings: The actual article contains p, a and math-renderer elements; no bold/italic/headings/tables, and all 68 P labels remain visible plain paragraph text.

Body font-weight uses --base-text-weight-normal with 400 fallback; current root definitions set 400. The .markdown-body scope sets sans-serif stack, font-size 16px and line-height 1.5. Paragraph margin-bottom is --base-size-16.

All 38 candidate font rules inspected against actual elements and full ancestor classes. Bold/italic rules for b/strong/dfn/headings/dt/table headers and UI or brand scopes have absent required tags/classes. No matching rule or inline style was found that forces bold or italic prose.

Inline math wrappers are inline-block, display math block. math-renderer has max-width:100% and overflow:auto; inline wrappers have bottom alignment and overflow:auto hidden. These are declarations only; glyphs, clipping and client-produced inner math were not observed.
Current HTML data-a11y-link-underlines=true matches the .markdown-body link underline selector; actual links remain inline text links. No source links carry the theme-only hide fragments.
PageLayout flex scopes match ancestors; their data-is-hidden selectors do not match present attributes. No actual article/ancestor inline font-weight or font-style override exists.
Inactive data-href theme inventory is retained separately; only actual href stylesheets were fetched. No claim about alternate user theme activation or computed cascade.
limits: CSS extraction is a conservative leaf-declaration inventory, not a complete CSS parser/cascade/selector implementation. Candidate conclusions are manual static inspection.
MathJax execution, screenshots, responsive pixels, actual click/scroll landing and live font rasterization were not observed.

fresh_revision_evidence.claim: Fresh CSS/DOM inspected. Four newly named assets differ only in sourceMappingURL comments, proved by full comparison after removing only those comments. No old fetch substituted. Initial shortcut expecting full URL/hash identity failed and is preserved.
